Let me analyze the teaching examples more carefully to identify the correction rules.

Looking at Example 1 (2024-08-12):
- History: prices declining from 72.65 → 70.14 → 68.16 → ... → 62.82 by day 30
- Model forecast: 72.54 → 71.90 → 71.11 → 70.01 → 63.39 (at day 30)
- True outcome: 72.65 → 71.29 → 70.49 → 62.82 (at day 30)

The model is still forecasting too high! Looking at the divergence:

Day 1: Model 72.54 vs True 72.65 (off by -0.11)
Day 2: Model 70.98 vs True 71.29 (off by -0.31)
